A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
αvβ3 is a critical regulator of fibroblast mechanotransduction of provisional ECM strain stiffening in progressive fibrosis.

the mechanical properties of the ECM in fibrotic regions of the lung are similar to normal lung tissue.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the mechanical properties of the ECM can drive fibrotic phenotypes in fibroblasts in vitro and in vivo, and that the mechanical cues from the ECM are mediated, in part by αvβ1 integrin and Thy-1.
fibroblasts are mechanosensitive, and that the mechanical properties of the extracellular matrix (i.e., stiffness) is a critical regulator of fibroblast behavior and the progression of fibrosis.

fibroblasts in the fibroblastic focus (FF) of idiopathic pulmonary fibroblast (IPF) have a similar mechanical environment as that of normal lung tissue and that fibroblast contractility drives the stiffening of this provisional matrix.
